mapper.sql: id, region, match_type, match_key, detail, teams, priority, alias_text, enabled, memo, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_automatic_notice_rule WHERE region = #{region} ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM tb_automatic_notice_rule WHERE region = #{region} AND enabled = 'Y' ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM tb_automatic_notice_rule ORDER BY region, priority ASC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_automatic_notice_rule ( region, match_type, match_key, detail, teams, priority, alias_text, enabled, memo ) VALUES ( #{region}, #{matchType}, #{matchKey}, #{detail}, #{teams}, #{priority}, #{aliasText}, #{enabled}, #{memo} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE detail = VALUES(detail), teams = VALUES(teams), priority = VALUES(priority), alias_text = VALUES(alias_text), enabled = VALUES(enabled), memo = VALUES(memo)
